notablePrerequisites:
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Voyaging Satyr.
description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{U}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Coral Atoll.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat any number of times.
